pages.text: Drop any armor into a Tetra workbench's input slot and it comes back $(bold)Reforged$(): modular, hone-able and ready for upgrades.$(br2)Reforging brings Tetra's modules and honing to the armor slot. Vanilla iron, an ISS Cultist Hood, Aether Phoenix and an Aquaculture diving helmet all reforge.

pages.title: How to Reforge
pages.text: $(bold)Put the armor in the input slot.$() The replacement happens automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Specialized armor keeps its identity:$() its school spell power, set bonus, Apotheosis affixes, enchantments and original look.$(br2)$(bold)Vanilla iron, gold, diamond and netherite$() get the modular shape with an iron-tier module pre-installed; upgrade it at the workbench.

pages.title: Module Slots
pages.text: Each reforged piece has 4 slots: a plate and three minor slots.$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$(): crown, visor, strap, crest$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$(): chest plate, chest lining, trim, pauldrons$(br)$(thing)Leggings$(): leg plate, belt, cuisses, greaves$(br)$(thing)Boots$(): boot sole, heel, boot lining, lacing$(br2)Every slot offers several modules: five plate builds per piece, three of each minor.

pages.title: Plates
pages.text: $(bold)Plates$() (crown, chest plate, leg plate, boot sole) take a metal, a gem, a skin or a themed material. Their armor scales with the material: Tetra multiplies the module's armor by the material's primary stat.$(br2)The runed and vestment plates are the mage builds: less armor, plus max mana, spell power and cooldown or mana regen. The expansion has plate variants for 62 metals and more than 30 gems from the pack's mods.

pages.title: Minor Slots
pages.text: Minor modules add small extras and take metal, fabric or leather, depending on the module. A few examples:$(br2)$(thing)Chain strap, chain belt, iron lacing$(): knockback resistance$(br)$(thing)Silk lining$(): max mana and mana regen$(br)$(thing)Sash, cloth cuisses, silk lacing$(): max mana$(br)$(thing)Goggles$(): max mana and spell power$(br)$(thing)Gilded trim$(): luck

pages.title: Themed Materials
pages.text: Any module can be made of a $(bold)themed material$() instead. Each themed module adds:$(br2)$(thing)Fire$() (Cinder Essence), $(thing)Ice$() (Frozen Bone), $(thing)Lightning$() (Lightning Bottle), $(thing)Holy$() (Divine Pearl), $(thing)Blood$() (Blood Vial): $(item)+10%$() to that school's spell power$(br2)$(thing)Ender$() (Ender Pearl), $(thing)Nature$() (Oak Sapling), $(thing)Shadow$() (Ghast Tear): $(item)+5%$() spell power in every school

pages.title: Stack Identity Bonuses
pages.text: Themed modules stack with a specialized skin's own attributes. A $(thing)Cultist Hood$() (skin: +5% blood spell power) with a $(thing)Blood visor$() (+10% blood) gives $(item)+15% blood spell power$() on the helmet.$(br2)A $(thing)Phoenix chestplate$() with a $(thing)Fire chest lining$() adds $(item)+10% fire spell power$() to the chestplate.$(br2)Mixing schools is allowed but usually wasteful. Match the skin's school.

pages.title: Honing
pages.text: Each slot has a 5-level honing track for its signature stat:$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$(): armor toughness (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$(): armor (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Leggings$(): knockback resistance (+0.02 to +0.10)$(br)$(thing)Boots$(): movement speed (+0.001 to +0.005)

pages.title: Honing, cont.
pages.text: Hone with the same hammer tiers as spellbooks: gold (L1), iron (L2), steel (L3), diamond (L4), netherite (L5).$(br2)At L3, apply the $(bold)settled$() schematic to lock the slot's identity and gain a small cross-stat bonus.

pages.title: Specialized Skins
pages.text: Dozens of specialized sets carry their signature attributes through reforging, among them ISS, Aether, Twilight Forest, Cataclysm, Aquaculture, Forbidden & Arcanus, Undergarden, Deeper & Darker, Botania, Blue Skies and Deep Aether.$(br2)Each set's armor, toughness, Spell Power and school-specific Spell Power survive the conversion, and the set keeps its original appearance.

pages.title: Set Bonuses
pages.text: $(bold)Set bonuses persist through reforging.$() Wear 4 reforged pieces of one set identity and the original full-set bonus fires automatically:$(br2)$(thing)Phoenix$(): fire immunity$(br)$(thing)Neptune$(): water breathing + dolphin's grace$(br)$(thing)Aquaculture Neptunium$(): water breathing$(br)$(thing)Yeti$(): strength$(br)$(thing)Gravitite$(): jump boost II$(br)$(thing)Ignitium / Fiery$(): fire immunity

pages.title: Set Bonuses, cont.
pages.text: A mixed set loses the set bonus, though each piece's base attributes still apply.$(br2)$(bold)Next: drop a spare iron chestplate into a Tetra workbench.$()
